office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Matthew Baldock, appointed to the District Court in 2023, is the only candidate. Elected by South District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2023 and a Snohomish County deputy prosecutor for 21 years, running unopposed.
highlights: Appointed to the South District Court in 2023 [S1]
21 years as a Snohomish County deputy prosecutor, including chief of the criminal division [S1]
Former Court of Appeals law clerk [S1]
